outgoing.name: 14th century
outgoing.excerpt: Public races organized by the Contrade were popular from the 14th century on; called palii alla lunga, they were run across the whole city.

outgoing.name: Water Buffalo
outgoing.excerpt: The first such races were on buffalo-back and called bufalate; asinate, races on donkey-back, later took their place, while horse-racing continued elsewhere.
